summary: Frontend-only retest of MonthCarousel new spec (5 consecutive months from current month with 'Próximamente' placeholders, consecutive extension when a far trip exists). Today = 2026-08-27, DB has 3 upcoming trips (2026-09-22, 2026-10-08, 2026-11-05). Home (/): exactly 5 cards month-card-2026-7..2026-11 in order Ago(Próximamente, disabled, bg #D7D6CF, cursor-default)/Sep(1 viaje)/Oct(1 viaje)/Nov(1 viaje)/Dic(Próximamente, disabled); no month-carousel-prev/next in DOM; click on Agosto/Diciembre blocked by disabled attr and no month-panel rendered; clicking Sep/Oct/Nov opens month-panel with the correct trip. /destinos: identical result (5 cards, no arrows, panel works). EXTENDED CASE: seeded 1 admin trip start_date 2027-03-15 -> carousel rendered 8 consecutive cards with NO gaps (Ago2026..Mar2027, Dic/Ene/Feb as Próximamente disabled, Mar2027 '1 viaje' clickable), month-carousel-prev/next appeared, prev was DISABLED at the resting position (scrollLeft=80 baseline fix works), next scrolled the rail 80->592 and self-disabled at the end revealing Marzo 2027, prev then scrolled back and became disabled exactly at scrollLeft=80 with Agosto 2026 as the leftmost card (never any month before Agosto). Test trip deleted; carousel returned to 5 cards (verified desktop and mobile 390px). Zero JS console errors / pageerrors on all runs. All 7 requested requirements PASS.

issues: When the rail is scrollable (extended >5-month case at 1920px, or mobile 390px), it rests at scrollLeft = inner padding (80px / 20px), so the first month card sits 80px (desktop) / 20px (mobile) to the LEFT of the heading gutter - on mobile Agosto is flush against the screen edge while the heading has a 20px gutter. Cosmetic only; arrow enable/disable logic is now correct.
At 1920px six 220px cards would fit, so the 5-month window is not visually enforced by width - only by the group count (cosmetic, matches spec)

action_items: Optional (LOW): align the first month card with the section gutter when the rail is scrollable (use scroll-padding-left instead of -mx/px padding), so the card row lines up with the heading.
critical_code_review_comments: MonthCarousel: api.get('/trips') still has no .catch and no loading/error state - a failed request leaves the calendar silently empty with no error UI.
scroll() still depends on hardcoded CARD_STEP=236 and setTimeout(300); prefer measuring the card width and relying solely on the onScroll handler.

baselineScrollLeft is captured on the first updateScrollState call after a groups change; if the browser restores a different scroll position (e.g. bfcache/back navigation) the baseline could be captured mid-scroll and mis-disable prev. Consider computing the minimum as 0 + scroll padding explicitly.
